title: Smart Campus Navigation & Interactive Event Map
description: A high-speed interactive map for new students and visitors to navigate campus buildings, lecture halls, labs, and live campus fest events. We need a frontend teammate to implement the map rendering layer and filter controls for department buildings.

title: College Canteen Food Pre-Ordering & Queue Buster
description: Solves the 20-minute rush between lectures by enabling students to browse the daily canteen menu, pre-order meals, and get live token updates. Looking for a backend developer to build robust order validation endpoints and database schemas.

title: Hostel Maintenance & Asset Complaint Desk
description: A digital tracking system replacing paper complaint registers in student hostels. Students can log electrical, plumbing, or Wi-Fi issues with room tags and track resolution status in real time with automated warden escalations.

title: Automated Lecture Summarizer & Note Generator using LLMs
description: An AI tool that ingests audio/video lecture recordings or syllabus PDF documents and produces concise chapter summaries, formula sheets, and self-test flashcards. Need an ML engineer to build embedding pipelines and prompt workflows.

title: Campus Lost and Found Portal with Image Similarity Matching
description: Students frequently misplace ID cards, calculators, chargers, and notebooks across campus libraries and auditoriums. This portal allows uploaders to post photos of found items and uses image embeddings to notify matching claim requests automatically.

title: HackIndia 2026: Offline Disaster Relief Aid Distribution Platform
description: Building our submission for the national 36-hour HackIndia hackathon! Our idea coordinates emergency supply distribution in offline or low-connectivity zones using local sync protocols and mesh relays. Looking for a strong problem solver to join our core team.

title: Student Placement Drive & Mock Interview Preparation Tracker
description: A student dashboard to track on-campus placement schedules, company eligibility criteria, aptitude test dates, and peer-to-peer mock interview practice. Seeking a frontend developer to create intuitive company profile and timeline cards.

title: Peer-to-Peer Campus Textbook & Lab Equipment Exchange
description: A platform for senior students to hand down expensive semester textbooks, lab coats, drafting kits, and electronics kits to incoming freshers at fair rates or free exchange. Need a backend dev to build search indexing and verification logic.

title: Campus Electric Shuttle Live GPS Tracking System
description: Tracks university internal electric shuttles and gives students live estimated arrival times (ETA) at various hostel and department stops. Seeking an enthusiastic mobile developer to build real-time GPS map views.

title: Automated Course Attendance & Proxy Alert System
description: An automated system helping course representatives and professors log attendance with QR verification, flagging low attendance thresholds automatically before students get barred from end-semester exams.

title: AI Resume Keyword Matcher for College Placement Drives
description: Parses student resumes and compares them against specific tech job descriptions from visiting campus recruiters (Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, etc.), recommending missing keywords and skill badge improvements before application deadlines.

title: College Sports Fest Live Scoreboard & Fixture Management
description: A fast-updating scoreboard and bracket manager for the annual inter-college sports meet (Cricket, Football, Badminton, Basketball). We need a responsive frontend dev to build the live match card and standings table.

title: Smart Lab Hardware Equipment & Sensor Kit Reservation System
description: A department inventory management system that lets student project teams reserve Arduino kits, oscilloscope stations, robotic arms, and 3D printers, reducing scheduling conflicts during capstone submissions.

title: University Open-Source Club CLI & Timetable Scraping API
description: An open-source developer project creating a unified terminal CLI and JSON API for student timetables, exam room seatings, and university announcements. Open to all students who want to learn Git workflows and make open-source pull requests.

title: Computer Lab Energy & Workstation Monitor
description: Analyzing power usage and idle compute time across university department computer labs to recommend automated shutdown schedules. Seeking a data analyst to clean power meter logs and construct visual energy savings reports.
